title: Understanding Overfitting
text: Overfitting occurs when a model learns the training data too well, including its noise and outliers, which may not generalize well to new data.

title: Cross-Validation Basics
text: In k-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into k subsets. The model is trained on k-1 subsets and validated on the remaining subset. This process is repeated k times.

title: Training and Validation Sets
text: Typically, the training set is used to train the model, and the validation set is used to evaluate its performance. Using the test set for validation can lead to overfitting.

title: Analyzing the Modification
text: Consider what happens when the test set is used for validation instead of a separate validation set. Does this affect the model's ability to generalize?
